title: Red Dead Redemption 2
summary: Outlaw Arthur Morgan's story in a huge open-world 1899 Wild West.

moments.label: Chapter One Begins
moments.detail: The gang seeks shelter from a harsh blizzard in the mountains after a botched ferry job.

moments.label: Setting Up Camp
moments.detail: The gang arrives at an abandoned mining town to set up a temporary camp and warm up.

moments.label: Homestead Ambush
moments.detail: Arthur and Dutch scout an abandoned homestead and confront a group of O'Driscoll boys inside.

moments.label: Rescuing Mrs. Adler
moments.detail: Arthur and Dutch find a terrified woman named Mrs. Adler hiding inside the homestead.

moments.label: Searching for John Marston
moments.detail: Arthur and Javier brave the blizzard to search the mountains for a missing John Marston.

moments.label: Finding John Marston
moments.detail: Arthur and Javier locate a freezing and mauled John Marston out in the deep snow.

moments.label: Escaping the Ambush
moments.detail: Arthur and Javier fight off pursuing O'Driscoll members while escorting John back to safety.

moments.label: Planning the O'Driscoll Camp Raid
moments.detail: Dutch outlines a plan to scout and ambush the O'Driscoll camp near the lake to get supplies.

moments.label: O'Driscoll Camp Raid
moments.detail: The gang launches a violent surprise attack on the O'Driscoll camp in the snowy mountains.

moments.label: Capturing Kieran Duffy
moments.detail: Arthur chases down a fleeing O'Driscoll member and captures him alive to interrogate him.

moments.label: Interrogating the Prisoner
moments.detail: The gang brings the captive O'Driscoll back to camp to tie him up and extract information.

moments.label: Hunting Deer
moments.detail: Arthur and Charles track and hunt deer in the snow to feed camp.

moments.label: Camp Conversation
moments.detail: Charles and Arthur talk about the harsh weather and the O'Driscoll gang.

moments.label: Bear Attack
moments.detail: A grizzly bear startles the group on the trail, prompting a detour.

moments.label: Skinning Deer
moments.detail: Arthur helps Pearson skin the hunted deer back at the camp.

moments.label: Planning the Train Job
moments.detail: Dutch and Hosea argue with John about planning a train robbery.

moments.label: Setting the Detonator
moments.detail: Arthur helps Bill set up the explosive charge by the train tracks.

moments.label: Train Robbery Ambush
moments.detail: The gang ambushes Leviticus Cornwall's private train in the snow.

moments.label: Opening the Safe
moments.detail: Arthur and the gang search Cornwall's private car and crack the safe.

moments.label: Leaving the Mountains
moments.detail: The gang finally leaves the snowy mountains and heads east toward Valentine.

moments.label: Broken Wagon Wheel
moments.detail: The gang fixes a broken wagon wheel while traveling along the river.

moments.label: Charles's Past
moments.detail: Charles talks with Arthur about his past and growing up on the run.

moments.label: Arriving at Horseshoe Overlook
moments.detail: The gang arrives at Horseshoe Overlook and sets up their new camp.

moments.label: New Beginnings
moments.detail: The gang settles into Horseshoe Overlook as Dutch makes new plans.
